Advertisement for Senior Research Fellow
Applications are invited from eligible and motivated candidates for one temporary position of Senior Research
Fellow SRF for the ANRF funded Project title: Dissecting 14-3-3 Regulation of the RhoA-HSPA1A Axis to
Reveal Therapeutic Opportunities in Cancer Cell Migration. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus
with the project. The other details related to the position are provided below.

Application and selection
• Eligible candidates are invited to attend a walk-in interview on 29 September 2026 at 11 a.m. in
the Department of Biochemistry at the University of Kashmir.
• Candidates should bring original certificates and other supporting documents for eligibility.
• NO TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
